# CS IMPACT ANALYSIS: Rewards Earning Rules Display

## CONTACT DRIVERS (maximum 5, highest likelihood only):

1. **"Why did I get 2% cashback instead of 5%?"**
   - Scenario: User expected higher cashback rate based on merchant category but received lower rate; doesn't understand exclusions or spend thresholds
   - Likelihood: **High**
   - PRD gap: **No** — PRD doesn't specify how exclusions, merchant categorization errors, or threshold logic will be explained

2. **"Where can I see my cashback calculation breakdown?"**
   - Scenario: User sees total cashback earned but can't find transaction-level detail showing which rate applied to which purchase
   - Likelihood: **High**
   - PRD gap: **Partial** — Feature shows "why they earned" but unclear if this is transaction-level or summary-level visibility

3. **"My transaction shows wrong merchant category"**
   - Scenario: User shopped at grocery store but transaction coded as 'general retail' earning lower cashback; wants correction and rate adjustment
   - Likelihood: **High**
   - PRD gap: **No** — No mention of MCC dispute handling or correction workflow

4. **"Cashback not credited yet for eligible transaction"**
   - Scenario: User made qualifying purchase 3 days ago, sees it should earn 5% based on rules display, but cashback still pending/not visible
   - Likelihood: **Medium**
   - PRD gap: **No** — No mention of crediting timelines, pending states, or settlement delays in rules display

5. **"Spend threshold not updating correctly"**
   - Scenario: User spent ₹18,000 toward ₹20,000 monthly threshold but display shows ₹15,000; questions if they'll unlock higher tier rewards
   - Likelihood: **Medium**
   - PRD gap: **No** — No mention of real-time vs. batch threshold tracking or excluded transaction types

---

## COMPETITOR CX BENCHMARK:

### High-likelihood driver 1: Rate variance explanation
- **Competitor**: Scapia (scapia.cards)
- **Approach**: Shows spend threshold requirements upfront ("Unlocks on combined monthly spend of ₹20,000") with clear milestone tracking in app
- **Type**: Self-serve with in-app progress bars
- **PIXEL should**: Add visual threshold tracker showing "₹X more to unlock Y% rate" before transaction, not just post-transaction explanation
- **Source**: https://www.scapia.cards/

### High-likelihood driver 2: Transaction-level breakdown
- **Competitor**: US credit card issuers (per Corporate Insight research)
- **Approach**: Reward redemption interfaces show per-transaction earning detail with expandable rows showing rate applied, category detected, and points earned
- **Type**: Self-serve via transaction history drill-down
- **PIXEL should**: Make every transaction tappable to reveal: merchant name, MCC code, rate applied, threshold status at time of transaction
- **Source**: https://corporateinsight.com/credit-card-reward-redemption-interface-features-and-design/

### High-likelihood driver 3: MCC disputes
- **Competitor**: Federal Bank/Scapia partnership (Concentrix support model)
- **Approach**: Dedicated customer support team handles card transaction disputes including merchant category corrections
- **Type**: Agent-assisted with 7-10 day resolution SLA
- **PIXEL should**: Build in-app dispute flow with photo upload (receipt showing actual merchant type) and auto-escalation to Zeta for MCC correction
- **Source**: https://www.federal.bank.in/documents/d/guest/cardholder-agreement-v10-27_02_26-2-

---

## FAQ COVERAGE (maximum 5 only):

**FAQ 1:**
- **Question**: "Why did I only get 1% cashback when the app says I should get 5%?"
- **Answer**: "Cashback rates depend on merchant category and monthly spend. Check your transaction details: tap the transaction > see 'Category Detected' and 'Threshold Status'. If you hadn't reached ₹20,000 spend that month, base rate applies. If category looks wrong, tap 'Dispute Category'."
- **Escalation needed**: No (unless dispute filed)

**FAQ 2:**
- **Question**: "Where can I see exactly how much cashback each purchase earned?"
- **Answer**: "Open PIXEL app > Transactions tab > tap any transaction. You'll see: Amount Spent, Category, Cashback Rate Applied, Cashback Earned. Scroll down for 'Why This Rate?' explanation showing your threshold status at purchase time."
- **Escalation needed**: No

**FAQ 3:**
- **Question**: "The app says I shopped at a restaurant but it was a grocery store - how do I fix this?"
- **Answer**: "Tap the transaction > 'Category looks wrong?' > Upload photo of receipt showing merchant type > Submit. We'll review with our card network partner within 5 business days. If approved, cashback difference will be credited within 3 days of approval."
- **Escalation needed**: Yes (to Zeta ops for MCC correction)

**FAQ 4:**
- **Question**: "I made a purchase 4 days ago but cashback still not showing - when will I get it?"
- **Answer**: "Cashback appears as 'Pending' within 24 hours of transaction settlement (usually 1-2 days after purchase). It credits to your account within 3 days after appearing as Pending. Check transaction status: tap transaction > see 'Cashback Status'. If 'Not Eligible', tap to see why."
- **Escalation needed**: No (unless >7 days and still pending)

**FAQ 5:**
- **Question**: "My spend tracker shows ₹16,000 but I've spent ₹19,000 this month - why is it wrong?"
- **Answer**: "Threshold tracker excludes: EMI transactions, fuel surcharge reversals, refunded purchases, and wallet loads. Tap 'Monthly Spend Breakdown' to see included vs. excluded transactions. Only retail purchases on card count toward thresholds."
- **Escalation needed**: No

---

## AGENT CENTRE REQUIREMENTS:

**Must be visible to CS agents:**
- Transaction-level cashback calculation (amount, rate applied, category/MCC code, threshold status at time of purchase) — **NOT IN PRD**
- User's current month spend toward each threshold tier with real-time update timestamp — **NOT IN PRD**
- Cashback crediting status (pending/credited/failed) with settlement dates — **NOT IN PRD**
- List of excluded transaction types for this user (EMIs, reversals, refunds) — **NOT IN PRD**
- Historical rate changes if user's tier changed mid-month — **NOT IN PRD**
- MCC dispute history (filed/under review/resolved) with Zeta ticket IDs — **NOT IN PRD**
- Merchant name vs. MCC code mismatch flag for common dispute scenarios — **NOT IN PRD**
- User's card program type (some HDFC cards may have different reward structures) — **NOT IN PRD**
- Backend calculation logs showing why specific rate was applied — **NOT IN PRD**

---

## ERROR SCREEN AUDIT:

**Error 1: Cashback calculation unavailable**
- Scenario: Backend service timeout when user taps transaction to see earning breakdown
- Current PRD handling: **Not documented**
- Recommended next action: "Calculation details temporarily unavailable. Your cashback is safe and will credit on schedule. Tap 'Notify Me' to get details via notification when available."

**Error 2: Threshold tracker out of sync**
- Scenario: Real-time spend calculation fails; tracker shows stale data from 6 hours ago
- Current PRD handling: **Not documented**
- Recommended next action: "Spend tracker last updated [time]. Refresh in 30 minutes for latest. Your cashback rates are calculated at transaction time, not based on this display."

**Error 3: MCC dispute submission failed**
- Scenario: User uploads receipt but submission fails due to network/backend error
- Current PRD handling: **Not documented**
- Recommended next action: "Dispute not submitted. Your receipt is saved in Drafts. Try again now or we'll auto-retry in 1 hour and notify you."

**Error 4: Transaction details not found**
- Scenario: User taps transaction but earning rules data not available (transaction too old or data not migrated)
- Current PRD handling: **Not documented**
- Recommended next action: "Earning details available for transactions from [date]. For older transactions, contact support with transaction ID for manual breakdown."

**Error 5: Rate explanation service down**
- Scenario: "Why this rate?" explanation engine unavailable
- Current PRD handling: **Not documented**
- Recommended next action: "Detailed explanation temporarily unavailable. You earned [X]% based on [category] and [threshold tier]. Full details available in 'Rewards Rules' section."

---

## ESCALATION PATHS:

**Scenario 1: MCC code correction request**
- Who handles it: **Zeta ops** (card network partner manages merchant category codes)
- Expected resolution time: 5-7 business days (requires Zeta to submit dispute to Visa/Mastercard network)

**Scenario 2: Cashback not credited after 10 days**
- Who handles it: **Tier-2 CS** → escalate to bank reconciliation team if transaction settled but cashback failed
- Expected resolution time: 3-5 business days for investigation + manual credit

**Scenario 3: Threshold calculation dispute (user claims tracker wrong)**
- Who handles it: **Tier-2 CS** with access to backend calculation logs and excluded transaction audit trail
- Expected resolution time: 24-48 hours for log review and explanation

**Scenario 4: Rate applied doesn't match published rules**
- Who handles it: **Bank team** (product/compliance) if rules engine bug or rate card discrepancy identified
- Expected resolution time: 7-10 days (requires code fix if systemic issue, immediate manual credit if one-off)

**Scenario 5: Bulk cashback correction needed (system error affected multiple users)**
- Who handles it: **Bank team** + Zeta ops for batch reprocessing
- Expected resolution time: 10-15 days for identification, approval, batch credit run

---

## TICKET DEFLECTION OPPORTUNITIES:

**Opportunity 1: Interactive "Why this rate?" explainer with visual threshold progress**
- What to build: Tap any transaction → see animated breakdown: "You earned 2% because: ✓ Grocery category (base 2%) ✗ Haven't reached ₹20,000 spend (need ₹4,200 more for 5%)"
- Estimated ticket reduction: **35%** (addresses drivers 1, 2, 5)
- Complexity: **Medium** (requires real-time threshold calculation API and transaction-level metadata)

**Opportunity 2: Pre-transaction rate preview**
- What to build: Before payment, show "This purchase will earn X% cashback" based on current merchant category and threshold status
- Estimated ticket reduction: **20%** (prevents expectation mismatch before transaction happens)
- Complexity: **High** (requires merchant category prediction at POS and real-time spend calculation)

**Opportunity 3: Self-serve MCC dispute flow with instant category override for common cases**
- What to build: "Category wrong?" button → select correct category from list → upload receipt → auto-approve if merchant in known-mismatch database, else route to Zeta
- Estimated ticket reduction: **25%** (addresses driver 3)
- Complexity: **Medium** (needs receipt OCR, known-mismatch merchant database, Zeta API integration)

**Opportunity 4: Proactive notifications for threshold milestones**
- What to build: Push notification when user is ₹2,000 away from next tier: "Spend ₹2,000 more this month to unlock 5% on dining"
- Estimated ticket reduction: **15%** (reduces confusion about why rate changed mid-month)
- Complexity: **Low** (threshold monitoring job + notification service)

**Opportunity 5: Cashback crediting timeline tracker**
- What to build: Transaction detail shows: "Cashback status: Pending → Expected credit: Dec 28" with progress bar (Transaction Settled → Cashback Calculated → Credited)
- Estimated ticket reduction: **25%** (addresses driver 4)
- Complexity: **Low** (display settlement status from existing card processing data)

---

## OVERALL CS READINESS SCORE: 4/10
